title.zh: 【慢雾：GitHub 伪装成 Solidity 面试练习的项目暗藏窃密后门】
title.en: 【慢雾：GitHub 伪装成 Solidity 面试练习的项目暗藏窃密后门】

current_state.zh: SlowMist warned that a GitHub project disguised as a Solidity interview exercise hides a backdoor in VS Code settings that can execute remote scripts and exfiltrate wallet, browser, keychain, and local file data, with eight similar repositories identified.
